preheader: I made a homepage for {{company}}. Worth a look?
body: Then I looked at your website. The design looks older than the service you describe, and getting a free quote means finding an "email us" button.

body.text: So I made a cleaner, more modern homepage with a clear headline, a tap-to-call number and a quote form right on the page:

body: Why? We're a small studio building our portfolio, and {{who_they_are}} is exactly the kind of work we want to show.
Worth a look? If not, no worries.
